items.title: RefCell::try_borrow_mut
items.signature: pub fn try_borrow_mut(&self) -> Result<RefMut<'_, T>, BorrowMutError>
items.excerpt: Mutably borrows the wrapped value, returning an error if the value is currently borrowed.

items.title: HashMap::entry
items.signature: pub fn entry(&mut self, key: K) -> Entry<'_, K, V, A>
items.excerpt: Gets the given key’s corresponding entry in the map for in-place manipulation.

items.title: HashMap::get
items.signature: pub fn get<Q>(&self, k: &Q) -> Option<&V> where K: Borrow<Q>, Q: Hash + Eq + ?Sized
items.excerpt: Returns a reference to the value corresponding to the key.

items.title: HashMap::insert
items.signature: pub fn insert(&mut self, k: K, v: V) -> Option<V>
items.excerpt: Inserts a key-value pair into the map.

items.title: Entry::or_insert
items.signature: pub fn or_insert(self, default: V) -> &'a mut V
items.excerpt: Ensures a value is in the entry by inserting the default if empty, and returns a mutable reference to the value in the entry.

items.title: Entry::or_insert_with
items.signature: pub fn or_insert_with<F: FnOnce() -> V>(self, default: F) -> &'a mut V
items.excerpt: Ensures a value is in the entry by inserting the result of the default function if empty, and returns a mutable reference to the value in the entry.

items.title: Iterator::collect
items.signature: fn collect<B>(self) -> B where B: FromIterator<Self::Item>, Self: Sized
items.excerpt: Transforms an iterator into a collection.

items.title: Iterator::enumerate
items.signature: fn enumerate(self) -> Enumerate<Self> where Self: Sized
items.excerpt: Creates an iterator which gives the current iteration count as well as the next value.

items.title: Iterator::filter
items.signature:
fn filter

(self, predicate: P) -> Filter where Self: Sized, P: FnMut(&Self::Item) -> bool
items.excerpt: Creates an iterator which uses a closure to determine if an element should be yielded.

items.title: Iterator::filter_map
items.signature: fn filter_map<B, F>(self, f: F) -> FilterMap<Self, F> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(Self::Item) -> Option<B>
items.excerpt: Creates an iterator that both filters and maps.

items.title: Iterator::find
items.signature:
fn find

(&mut self, predicate: P) -> Option where Self: Sized, P: FnMut(&Self::Item) -> bool
items.excerpt: Searches for an element of an iterator that satisfies a predicate.

items.title: Iterator::fold
items.signature: fn fold<B, F>(self, init: B, f: F) -> B where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(B, Self::Item) -> B
items.excerpt: Folds every element into an accumulator by applying an operation, returning the final result.

items.title: Iterator::map
items.signature: fn map<B, F>(self, f: F) -> Map<Self, F> where Self: Sized, F: FnMut(Self::Item) -> B
items.excerpt: Takes a closure and creates an iterator which calls that closure on each element.

items.title: mem::replace
items.signature: pub const fn replace<T>(dest: &mut T, src: T) -> T
items.excerpt: Moves src into the referenced dest, returning the previous dest value.

items.title: mem::take
items.signature: pub fn take<T>(dest: &mut T) -> T where T: Default
items.excerpt: Replaces dest with the default value of T, returning the previous dest value.

items.title: Option::and_then
items.signature: pub fn and_then<U, F>(self, f: F) -> Option<U> where F: FnOnce(T) -> Option<U>
items.excerpt: Returns None if the option is None, otherwise calls f with the wrapped value and returns the result.

items.title: Option::as_ref
items.signature: pub const fn as_ref(&self) -> Option<&T>
items.excerpt: Converts from &Option<T> to Option<&T>.

items.title: Option::map
items.signature: pub fn map<U, F>(self, f: F) -> Option<U> where F: FnOnce(T) -> U
items.excerpt: Maps an Option<T> to Option<U> by applying a function to a contained value (if Some) or returns None (if None).

items.title: Option::ok_or_else
items.signature: pub fn ok_or_else<E, F>(self, err: F) -> Result<T, E> where F: FnOnce() -> E
items.excerpt: Transforms the Option<T> into a Result<T, E>, mapping Some(v) to Ok(v) and None to Err(err()).

items.title: Option::take
items.signature: pub const fn take(&mut self) -> Option<T>
items.excerpt: Takes the value out of the option, leaving a None in its place.

items.title: Option::unwrap_or_else
items.signature: pub fn unwrap_or_else<F>(self, f: F) -> T where F: FnOnce() -> T
items.excerpt: Returns the contained Some value or computes it from a closure.

items.title: slice::chunks
items.signature: pub fn chunks(&self, chunk_size: usize) -> Chunks<'_, T>
items.excerpt: Returns an iterator over chunk_size elements of the slice at a time, starting at the beginning of the slice.

items.title: slice::get
items.signature: pub fn get<I>(&self, index: I) -> Option<&<I as SliceIndex<[T]>>::Output> where I: SliceIndex<[T]>
items.excerpt: Returns a reference to an element or subslice depending on the type of index.

items.title: slice::get_mut
items.signature: pub fn get_mut<I>(&mut self, index: I) -> Option<&mut <I as SliceIndex<[T]>>::Output> where I: SliceIndex<[T]>
items.excerpt: Returns a mutable reference to an element or subslice depending on the type of index (see get) or None if the index is out of bounds.

items.title: slice::iter
items.signature: pub fn iter(&self) -> Iter<'_, T>
items.excerpt: Returns an iterator over the slice.

items.title: slice::iter_mut
items.signature: pub fn iter_mut(&mut self) -> IterMut<'_, T>
items.excerpt: Returns an iterator that allows modifying each value.

items.title: slice::len
items.signature: pub const fn len(&self) -> usize
items.excerpt: Returns the number of elements in the slice.

items.title: slice::sort_by_key
items.signature: pub fn sort_by_key<K, F>(&mut self, f: F) where F: FnMut(&T) -> K, K: Ord
items.excerpt: Sorts the slice in ascending order with a key extraction function, preserving initial order of equal elements.

items.title: slice::split_at_mut
items.signature: pub const fn split_at_mut(&mut self, mid: usize) -> (&mut [T], &mut [T])
items.excerpt: Divides one mutable slice into two at an index.

items.title: str::chars
items.signature: pub fn chars(&self) -> Chars<'_>
items.excerpt: Returns an iterator over the chars of a string slice.

items.title: str::get
items.signature: pub fn get<I>(&self, i: I) -> Option<&<I as SliceIndex<str>>::Output> where I: SliceIndex<str>
items.excerpt: Returns a subslice of str.

items.title: str::len
items.signature: pub const fn len(&self) -> usize
items.excerpt: Returns the length of self.

items.title: str::parse
items.signature: pub fn parse<F>(&self) -> Result<F, <F as FromStr>::Err> where F: FromStr
items.excerpt: Parses this string slice into another type.

items.title: str::split
items.signature:
pub fn split

(&self, pat: P) -> Split<'_, P> where P: Pattern
items.excerpt: Returns an iterator over substrings of this string slice, separated by characters matched by a pattern.

items.title: str::split_whitespace
items.signature: pub fn split_whitespace(&self) -> SplitWhitespace<'_>
items.excerpt: Splits a string slice by whitespace.

items.title: str::trim
items.signature: pub fn trim(&self) -> &str
items.excerpt: Returns a string slice with leading and trailing whitespace removed.

items.title: Result::and_then
items.signature: pub fn and_then<U, F>(self, op: F) -> Result<U, E> where F: FnOnce(T) -> Result<U, E>
items.excerpt: Calls op if the result is Ok, otherwise returns the Err value of self.

items.title: Result::as_ref
items.signature: pub const fn as_ref(&self) -> Result<&T, &E>
items.excerpt: Converts from &Result<T, E> to Result<&T, &E>.

items.title: Result::map
items.signature: pub fn map<U, F>(self, op: F) -> Result<U, E> where F: FnOnce(T) -> U
items.excerpt: Maps a Result<T, E> to Result<U, E> by applying a function to a contained Ok value, leaving an Err value untouched.

items.title: Result::map_err
items.signature: pub fn map_err<F, O>(self, op: O) -> Result<T, F> where O: FnOnce(E) -> F
items.excerpt: Maps a Result<T, E> to Result<T, F> by applying a function to a contained Err value, leaving an Ok value untouched.

items.title: String::into_bytes
items.signature: pub const fn into_bytes(self) -> Vec<u8>
items.excerpt: Converts a String into a byte vector.

items.title: String::len
items.signature: pub const fn len(&self) -> usize
items.excerpt: Returns the length of this String, in bytes, not chars or graphemes. In other words, it might not be what a human considers the length of the string.

items.title: String::pop
items.signature: pub fn pop(&mut self) -> Option<char>
items.excerpt: Removes the last character from the string buffer and returns it.

items.title: String::push_str
items.signature: pub fn push_str(&mut self, string: &str)
items.excerpt: Appends a given string slice onto the end of this String.

items.title: String::retain
items.signature: pub fn retain<F>(&mut self, f: F) where F: FnMut(char) -> bool
items.excerpt: Retains only the characters specified by the predicate.

items.title: Arc::make_mut
items.signature: pub fn make_mut(this: &mut Arc<T, A>) -> &mut T
items.excerpt: Makes a mutable reference into the given Arc.

items.title: Arc::new
items.signature: pub fn new(data: T) -> Arc<T>
items.excerpt: Constructs a new Arc<T>.

items.title: Mutex::lock
items.signature: pub fn lock(&self) -> LockResult<MutexGuard<'_, T>>
items.excerpt: Acquires a mutex, blocking the current thread until it is able to do so.

items.title: Mutex::try_lock
items.signature: pub fn try_lock(&self) -> TryLockResult<MutexGuard<'_, T>>
items.excerpt: Attempts to acquire this lock.

items.title: OnceLock::get_or_init
items.signature: pub fn get_or_init<F>(&self, f: F) -> &T where F: FnOnce() -> T
items.excerpt: Gets the contents of the cell, initializing it to f() if the cell was uninitialized.

items.title: mpsc::channel
items.signature: pub fn channel<T>() -> (Sender<T>, Receiver<T>)
items.excerpt: Creates a new asynchronous channel, returning the sender/receiver halves.

items.title: thread::scope
items.signature: pub fn scope<'env, F, T>(f: F) -> T where F: for<'scope> FnOnce(&'scope Scope<'scope, 'env>) -> T
items.excerpt: Creates a scope for spawning scoped threads.

items.title: thread::spawn
items.signature: pub fn spawn<F, T>(f: F) -> JoinHandle<T> where F: FnOnce() -> T + Send + 'static, T: Send + 'static
items.excerpt: Spawns a new thread, returning a JoinHandle for it.

items.title: Vec::dedup
items.signature: pub fn dedup(&mut self)
items.excerpt: Removes consecutive repeated elements in the vector according to the PartialEq trait implementation.

items.title: Vec::drain
items.signature: pub fn drain<R>(&mut self, range: R) -> Drain<'_, T, A> where R: RangeBounds<usize>
items.excerpt: Removes the subslice indicated by the given range from the vector, returning a double-ended iterator over the removed subslice.

items.title: Vec::len
items.signature: pub const fn len(&self) -> usize
items.excerpt: Returns the number of elements in the vector, also referred to as its ‘length’.

items.title: Vec::pop
items.signature: pub fn pop(&mut self) -> Option<T>
items.excerpt: Removes the last element from a vector and returns it, or None if it is empty.

items.title: Vec::push
items.signature: pub fn push(&mut self, value: T)
items.excerpt: Appends an element to the back of a collection.

items.title: Vec::remove
items.signature: pub fn remove(&mut self, index: usize) -> T
items.excerpt: Removes and returns the element at position index within the vector, shifting all elements after it to the left.

items.title: Vec::retain
items.signature: pub fn retain<F>(&mut self, f: F) where F: FnMut(&T) -> bool
items.excerpt: Retains only the elements specified by the predicate.

items.title: Vec::split_off
items.signature: pub fn split_off(&mut self, at: usize) -> Vec<T, A> where A: Clone
items.excerpt: Splits the collection into two at the given index.

items.title: Vec::swap_remove
items.signature: pub fn swap_remove(&mut self, index: usize) -> T
items.excerpt: Removes an element from the vector and returns it.

items.title: Vec::with_capacity
items.signature: pub fn with_capacity(capacity: usize) -> Vec<T>
items.excerpt: Constructs a new, empty Vec<T> with at least the specified capacity.
